.. _PAN:

PAN
===

Positions audio within the stereo field.
Values less than zero pan to the left. Values greater then zero pan to the right.

Arguments
---------

+-----------+------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Name      | Type       | Description                                          |
+===========+============+======================================================+
| pan       | ``float``  | Pan level.                                           |
+-----------+------------+------------------------------------------------------+

Input
-----

+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                                 |
+==========+==========+==================================================+
| ``s32v`` | PCM buffer. Stereo only.                                    |
+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+

Output
------

+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                                 |
+==========+==========+==================================================+
| ``s32v`` | PCM buffer with pan applied.                                |
+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+

Example
-------

.. code-block:: bash

   PAN -0.1
